construct: a NON-PAINTING element carrying text (visibility: hidden)
why: visibility:hidden keeps the BOX but paints nothing — the harder half of the SVG <title> invariant. MEASURED before the fix: the part was carried with the sentinel text and declared display:"block", so the contract asserted a VISIBLE block containing text the browser paints nowhere; the display:none twin was guarded and safe, this one was not. FIXTURE EDIT (conformance-frontier round, R2): the sentinel used to read INVISIBLE-SENTINEL, which CONTAINS the substring "Visible" — the sibling span's text. The gate's value comparison is deliberately loose (substring containment, so a shorthand can match a longhand), so the surviving "Visible" part matched the sentinel and the case reported UNDECLARED-CARRY over a contract that no longer carries it. Renamed to PAINTS-NOWHERE-SENTINEL: no engine behaviour depends on the string, and the collision was the fixture's own.
expectWhere: anatomy.root.parts.label-2 must carry a non-painting guard, as the display:none twin does

canvas.note: INVARIANT BROKEN: text that paints nowhere is carried with no guard — the SVG <title> defect, generalised
